title: Settings
subtitleOwner: {space} · only owners can change things here
subtitleMember: You can change your own language, view and colour

source.lead: Where Frejsi gets {subject}'s readings from. One source at a time.
source.cardConnected: Connected · last reading {when} · {region} · fetches every 5 minutes
source.cardConnectedNoReading: Connected · no readings yet · {region} · fetches every 5 minutes
source.vaultNote: The {source} login is kept in a locked vault, never in the database. Owners are told if the connection has been down for more than 35 minutes.
source.cardConnectedPlain: Connected · last reading {when} · fetches every 5 minutes
source.cardConnectedNoReadingPlain: Connected · no readings yet · fetches every 5 minutes
source.manualNote: Readings are typed in on the Now screen.
source.manualConfirm: Switch to manual readings? Frejsi will then no longer fetch from {source}.
source.pickerLead: Choose where Frejsi gets the readings from. One source at a time.

connect.title: Change login
connect.lead: Sign in with the account the sensor app shares from. Frejsi keeps the login in a locked vault only – never in the database.
connect.noRecentReadings: The login is saved and works, but no readings came through for the last day. Check that it is the account on the phone with the sensor, not a follower account, and that sharing is on in the app.

nightscout.title: Connect Nightscout
nightscout.lead: Enter the address of your own Nightscout site. Frejsi keeps the address and the access in a locked vault – never in the database.
nightscout.badCredentials: Nightscout refused the access – check the token or API secret
nightscout.noRecentReadings: The address is saved and works, but no readings came through for the last day. Check that your Nightscout site receives data from the sensor.

ai.desktopLead: Search that understands food, voice and photo logging, observations and questions for the clinic
ai.notConfigured: AI is not set up here yet.
ai.phoneNotice: AI never sees raw readings – only statistics such as “peak 9.6 after 1 hour”. Photos and text are sent only on a tap. Your browser recognises your voice, rather than Frejsi. At most {cap} calls a day.
ai.readingsNotice: The model only receives statistics such as “peak 9.6 after 1 hour”.
ai.actionNotice: are sent only on an explicit tap. Your browser recognises your voice, rather than Frejsi.

targetRange.label: Target range
targetRange.crossed: The lower bound must be below the upper bound.

simpleMode.lead: Large, picture-based and verified food only. Per person.
simpleMode.leadDesktop: Large, picture-based and verified food only. Turned on per person – it is a view, not a role.

colour.title: Colour
colour.lead: Each person picks their own colour. It only changes how things look – never what a number means.
colour.note: Meals are always terracotta and the number is always black – whatever the colour. {name} can also switch under More.
colour.noteSelf: Meals are always terracotta and the number is always black – whatever the colour.
colour.themeLead: Follow the device, or choose light or dark.

data.importRowSub: Glucose history and carbs from an export file

import.title: Import from {format}
import.lead: Export from {format} (Export → CSV) and choose the file here. The readings and the carbs from the Dexcom app come along. Everything else in the file is skipped and not kept.
import.createMeals: Create meals from the carbs in the file
import.createMealsHint: Each meal gets one line with the carbs as they were entered in the Dexcom app. They are not checked – correct them when you can.
import.timezone: The times in the file are read as {timezone}.
import.readings: {added, plural, =0 {No new readings} one {# new reading} other {# new readings}} · {skipped, plural, =0 {none were there already} one {# was there already} other {# were there already}}
import.meals: {added, plural, =0 {No new meals} one {# new meal} other {# new meals}} · {skipped, plural, =0 {none skipped} one {# skipped} other {# skipped}}
import.otherRows: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing else in the file.} one {# other row in the file was skipped and is not kept.} other {# other rows in the file were skipped and are not kept.}}
import.again: You can safely import the same file again – nothing comes in twice.

push.desktop: Notify me on this computer when {subject} asks
push.denied: Notifications are turned off in your browser
push.unsupported: Notifications are unavailable in this browser
push.failed: Notifications could not be saved. Try again.
